text: What should a woman bring to the table? If you ask a woman what a man must do, she can easily give you a list of 10, 20, maybe 30 points. Earn this much, be this tall, be emotionally intelligent, be confident, provide, protect, lead, be ambitious. There are countless female influencers telling women they are the prize, who deserve the best in life. I'm sure you've seen those videos, how much a man should earn, or what is a bare minimum for men. Fine, good for women actually. But now, ask the opposite question. Ask a man, what should a woman bring to the table? Most men struggle to name even 5 things. They may say, oh, she should be pretty, kind, maybe smart. And that's it. Most men don't even clearly understand what they are looking for in a woman. Most men barely have standards. They don't really care who is with them as long as she is attractive and gives them attention. And then they are shocked when their relationship turns into chaos. Women enter relationships with a checklist, be this, do that, live up to these expectations. Men enter relationships with, well, I kinda like her. And then I receive all these trash stories from subscribers. Cheating, disrespect, manipulation, drama. And the common theme is simple, no standards from the beginning. Guys, if you don't define what you require, you will accept whatever shows up. Have standards for the woman you want next to you. And to help you with that, today I'll give you 5 things a woman must bring to the table if you want to have a chance for a good, healthy relationship. And number one is loyalty. Those who've been on my channel for some time and watched the relationship story videos from subscribers perfectly understand how serious this problem is in modern society. Many women absolutely do not know how to stay faithful. And for many men, turning a blind eye to a woman's cheating is something completely normal and real. Realize this, cheating is simply unacceptable in a relationship. So if your woman cheats on you, she is no longer your woman. Therefore, the first thing a woman should bring to the table is loyalty. Number two, care. If you're sick, stressed, overwhelmed, does she care? Or does she make it about herself? A woman who cannot show care in your low moments shouldn't be next to you. Does she ask how you are? Does she try to help when you need it? Or does she disappear when things are not fun? Number three, ability to compromise. Relationship is not my way or nothing. It is about a balance. If you always adjust, if you always sacrifice, if you always adapt and she never bends, that's not love. That's imbalance. Compromise goes both ways. If she expects flexibility from you but offers none back, you don't need that. Number four, support. If you're working hard towards the future with her, building career or business, does she support you? Is she being grateful for your sacrifices and hard work? Or does she compare you to other men saying, why can't you be like a boyfriend of my friend? Why can't you earn more money? Why can't we travel every month? Why, why, why? If a woman doesn't support you as a man, she has no place in your life. And number five, respect. This one is the foundation. If she disrespects you publicly, if she allows her friends to mock you, if she talks badly about you behind your back, it's over. Respect is not optional. Without respect, attraction dies. Without respect, loyalty dies. Without respect, everything collapses. Guys, once again, have standards when it comes to women. Don't be afraid to speak them, feel them, and understand that you deserve more. Then you will be able to find a woman who will meet those standards.
